scripts.env:check: npx --yes eas-cli@latest env:list --environment production && npx --yes eas-cli@latest env:list --environment preview
scripts.test:android: npm run typecheck && npx --yes eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.build:android: npm run typecheck && npx --yes eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile play-internal
scripts.release:android: npm run typecheck && npx --yes eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile play-internal --auto-submit
scripts.build:ios: npm run typecheck && npx --yes eas-cli@latest build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.release:ios: npm run typecheck && npx --yes eas-cli@latest build --platform ios --profile production --auto-submit
